call_points.text: Chinese soda ash export prices at USD 160-180 FOB, with USD 170 seen as the bottom.
82.5 KTPA India salt plant to be operational by year-end, supplying from Q1FY28.
210 KTPA South India salt plant and 50 KTPA silica plant have 24-month execution, operational during 2028.
Kenya HFO hedged only to October; India limestone and energy costs at risk if conflict drags on.
Sodium-ion battery pilot to finish in 6-9 months; full-scale plant two years after that.
IMACID skipped production in Q1 on high sulfur prices; operations resumed this quarter.
Employee cost included a ₹43 Cr one-off reversal; normal run-rate would be ₹43 Cr higher.
The ₹100 Cr debottlenecking is expected on stream in 12-14 months with returns upwards of 20%.
call_points.versus_prior: timeline and return first given for the board-approved IVSD capex

call_points.text: Imports into India have halved from 70,000-100,000 tons a month pre-conflict, supporting domestic volumes.
Cost increases from the Middle East conflict have been passed on to customers in all regions, except UK where unhedged gas moves daily.
call_points.versus_prior: prior call flagged higher energy and shipping costs; now says these are passed through

call_points.text: Kenya has 45 days of HFO cover; beyond that, market HFO prices are up 50-60%.
US operations will not sell into unremunerative Southeast Asia; the last such shipment was a pre-existing contract.
India sodium bicarbonate output has risen from 140,000 to 290,000 tons and is fully sold, with NTPC the largest buyer.
No soda ash capex in the US until the cycle turns; investment stays focused on non-soda ash businesses.
A ₹1,837 Cr US goodwill impairment and ₹182 Cr deferred-tax write-off were booked amid current soda ash market conditions.
Debt-to-equity is 0.36, which the company calls low leverage for organic and inorganic growth.
Non-soda ash revenue grew 14% to ₹6,946 Cr in FY26 from ₹6,118 Cr.
The Singapore premium pharma-grade bicarb acquisition (Novabay) was completed in March 2026.
Global soda ash demand growth is expected to stay broadly flat near term on weak macro conditions and excess capacity.
The Middle East conflict has raised energy, raw material and shipping costs for soda ash producers in Europe, Türkiye and India.
The board recommends a dividend of ₹11 per share.

guidance.statement: FY27 capex guided at ₹1,300 Cr, mostly maintenance in Mithapur and US, with growth capex in South India and Singapore.
Debt expected to remain at similar levels to March 2026 (₹5,961 Cr) in FY27.
Annualised capex around the depreciation number, not to exceed it
India soda ash sustainable EBITDA margin
UK EBITDA positive and tending towards PBT breakeven for the full year

industry: Commodities > Chemicals > Chemicals & Petrochemicals > Commodity Chemicals

operating_notes.text: Q4FY26 basic chemistry products segment result was a loss of ₹1,802 Cr against a ₹84 Cr profit in Q4FY25, after a ₹1,837 Cr exceptional charge.
Specialty products revenue fell to ₹505 Cr in Q4FY26 from ₹667 Cr in Q3FY26, and the segment lost ₹46 Cr.
Power and fuel cost fell to ₹1,799 Cr in FY26 from ₹2,421 Cr in FY25, while raw material cost rose to ₹2,958 Cr from ₹2,560 Cr.
IVSD salt capacity at Mithapur is 1.60 MTPA running at 92% utilisation; a ₹100 Cr debottlenecking adds 82,500 TPA over the next 12 months.
FY26 sales volumes of soda ash, bicarb and salt were 5,358 Kts vs 5,218 Kts in FY25; Q4FY26 was 1,344 Kts vs 1,339 Kts a year ago.
Net external debt was ₹5,961 Cr at Mar-26 (excluding lease of ₹887 Cr) vs ₹4,884 Cr at Mar-25 (excluding lease of ₹768 Cr).
Installed capacity: India soda ash 1,091,000 MTPA, bicarb 290,000 MTPA, salt 1,600,000 MTPA; international soda ash 2,940,000 MTPA and bicarb 150,000 MTPA.
Mithapur facility achieved production of 1 MTPA of soda ash in FY26.
50 kT electric calciner soda ash plant in Kenya was operationalized.
Pearl Silica facility (3,000 MTPA) at Cuddalore and FOS L55 facility (4,500 MTPA) at Mambattu were commissioned during FY26.
China soda ash inventories are close to 1.8 million tons and stable; Chinese prices are flat at about 1,250 renminbi per ton.
Imports into India have halved from 70,000-100,000 tons a month pre-conflict; solar glass is expected to add 7,500-10,000 tons a month of dense ash demand initially.
India sodium bicarbonate capacity has risen from 140,000 to 290,000 tons and is fully sold, with NTPC the largest buyer.
Gujarat HC rejected pre-existing land rights over legacy open wastewater channels at Mithapur and ordered GPCB to assess environmental remediation and compensation.
India soda ash spot price raised about ₹2,000 per tonne; contracts reviewed quarterly.
Chinese soda ash inventories at an all-time high of 1.73 million mt.
Exports to Argentina and Chile rose 53% and 32% respectively.

timeline.summary: 2026-05-04: Board approved ₹100 Cr to debottleneck IVSD salt capacity at Mithapur by 82,500 TPA over the next 12 months.

2026-05-04: FY26 revenue fell 2% to ₹14,584 Cr and EBITDA 8% to ₹1,805 Cr on lower soda ash realisations; a ₹1,837 Cr US goodwill impairment and ₹182 Cr deferred-tax write-off took FY26 PAT after exceptional items to a ₹1,896 Cr loss.

2026-05-09: Q4FY26 call transcript: revenue fell 2% to ₹3,438 Cr and EBITDA to ₹274 Cr on weak soda ash prices; a ₹1,837 Cr US goodwill impairment and ₹159 Cr deferred tax write-off drove the loss; FY27 capex guided at ₹1,300 Cr with debt to stay near ₹5,961 Cr.
Tata Chemicals Limited announced its 87th Annual General Meeting on June 26, 2026, via video conferencing, with dividend record date set for June 10, 2026.

On May 25, 2026, the Gujarat High Court rejected Tata Chemicals' pre-existing claim over legacy wastewater channels at Mithapur and directed GPCB to assess environmental impact and compensation within three months.
On 27 July 2026 Tata Chemicals told analysts Q1FY27 consolidated revenue rose 14% YoY while EBITDA fell about ₹100 Cr, and guided FY27 capex at about FY26 depreciation of ₹1,200 Cr.
An MCIA tribunal unanimously rejected Allied Silica's ₹908 Cr claim against Tata Chemicals, directing a ₹1 Cr principal payment with interest.
